title: Walking the Work to the Accademia
note: Performance and meeting at the Accademia di Belle Arti di Venezia, promoted there by Prof. Gianpaolo Mazzoni, Professor of Sculpture. The works go by boat from the pavilion’s water gate on the Rio delle Galeazze, across the Bacino di San Marco and up the Giudecca canal to the Zattere, and students of his sculpture course, who helped make the works in the studio, carry them into the cloister. The hour in the cloister is for the Academy’s students and staff; afterwards the works go back to the pavilion by boat
